text:
matt: Heads-up — partner "AcmeAnalytics" wants sustained short-term burst for a nightly ingestion job next week. They asked for 5x their org quota for a 3-hour window. Is there a safe way to grant this without permanently changing tiers?

lena: We should avoid permanent increases. Two options: ephemeral override tokens or a scheduled 'burst voucher' that the platform applies and auto-reverts.

siva: +1 to auto-revert. Also need audit trail and rate-limit metrics hooked per key so we can revoke early if something goes sideways.

eva: From product pov, partners like this expect an easy UI flow. We already have the temporary-commit UI for Dedicated — can we reuse patterns?

dave: Can we do a short-lived signed token that carries override caps and expiry? Similar to signed URLs but for rate limits. Minimal plumbing on the routing side.

ops-bot: IncidentBot: note created — "partner-burst-exception-AcmeAnalytics" (link: https://redwood/infra/incidents/1876543210)

lena: Implementation concerns: routing layer needs to check override metadata per request. We currently fetch key metadata from cache; we can add an "override" field with a TTL. Cache invalidation not hard.

siva: Also need to ensure cost accounting: bill them for the extra tokens or map to pre-paid voucher. Telemetry should tag tokens with "voucher_id" for later chargebacks.

dave: Example high-level policy blob I sketched:
```json
{
  "key_id": "ak_live_XXXXX",
  "override": {
    "type": "burst_voucher",
    "max_rps": 1200,
    "token_quota": 150000,
    "starts_at": "2026-04-05T02:00:00Z",
    "expires_at": "2026-04-05T05:00:00Z",
    "voucher_id": "voucher_20260405_acme"
  }
}
```

eva: Nice. UX asks: console should show a simple "Create partner voucher" flow with 1) caps, 2) time window, 3) billing code, 4) audit owner. And a big red revoke button.

matt: For rollout, propose: 1) implement server-side support for override field and TTL, 2) add voucher creation API + console, 3) emit telemetry tags, 4) small canary with internal partner first.

siva: For safety add hard global guard: overrides cannot exceed X*org_quota (configurable platform-wide). Also require an on-call ACK for vouchers above threshold.

dave: We'll need to update the rate limiter to evaluate limits in this order: explicit per-request override -> per-key limit -> org limit -> global. Keep evaluation cheap.

lena: Ops ask: make sure we log both grant and revoke events to the audit stream (not just metrics). Also add a dashboard tile that shows active vouchers and current consumption by voucher_id.

matt: Can someone pick up a short RFC? Outline API shape, console mock, and a couple safety tests (revoke works, billing tag present). Aim for PR by EOD Friday.

eva: I'll draft the console mock and product acceptance criteria.

siva: I'll take the backend change (rate limiter + cache).

dave: I'll do voucher signing/token format and ingestion service changes.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: staging rollout scheduled 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC — will run migration add_override_field_v1 and feature flag "party/voucher-overrides"

matt: Thanks all. Quick checklist in thread: :eyes: 1) RFC, 2) feature flag, 3) telemetry tags, 4) dashboard tile, 5) on-call ACK for high-risk grants.

lena: One more thought — limit concurrent active vouchers per org to avoid leakage.

siva: +1. Also assert voucher lookup is cheap in hot path: store small override blob in memcache keyed by api_key_id.

eva: Will include the revoke UX: email + slack alerts when voucher is revoked early.

matt: Great — I'll kick off a partner comms note once we have rough timeline.

dave: FYI — related config in repo: repo:infra/quotas/policies.md (I'll add examples).

matt: End of thread.
